first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A foreground person with short brown hair, wearing a dark blue-gray top, brown pants, and a brown shoulder strap, crouching beside the counter and re-aiming while holding Weapon A.

entities.name: green foreground counter
entities.identification: The damaged teal wooden counter near Person A, with multiple exposed open sections in the frame beneath the slatted countertop.

entities.name: shop stall with a red roller shutter
entities.identification: The red rectangular shop stall on the image-right side of the passageway, with a gray roller shutter bearing a large red pattern and dark windowpanes on its side.

entities.name: wet flagstone passageway
entities.identification: The gray-brown paved passageway leading from the foreground to the steps, with reflections from standing water and scattered debris.

entities.name: distant curved building
entities.identification: The light-colored multistory building above and behind the shop stall, with a curved corner and green balcony edges.

entities.name: armed person near the steps
entities.identification: The group of people in front of the steps; initially, there is a dark-clothed person in the center and two overlapping people beside the fruit table, while in the final portion there are a standing person, a person lying down, and a human figure occluded beside the table.

entities.name: green open goods stall
entities.identification: The fixed green goods stall at the image-right edge, with multiple tiers of shelves inside a wide opening and diagonal braces and peeling panels on the outside.

entities.name: orange-fruit table
entities.identification: The low orange wooden display table in front of the shop stall with a red roller shutter, with a front formed by horizontal slats.

entities.name: blue-and-white steps
entities.identification: The multilevel wide steps at the far end of the passageway, with light-gray treads and blue-and-white block-patterned risers.

entities.name: raised market hall
entities.identification: The building behind the steps, partially occluded by stall racks, with an exposed reddish-brown pitched roof and dark eave edge.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The short handgun held by Person A, with a conspicuous silver-gray rectangular upper section and a grip mostly occluded by the hands.

entities.name: sky between the buildings
entities.identification: The light-blue and pale-white area of sky visible between the tops of the buildings.

entities.name: surrounding market buildings
entities.identification: The group of buildings with blue-gray and yellow-brown walls on both sides of the passageway, excluding separately listed buildings from being included again.

entities.name: hanging green plants along the building edge
entities.identification: The clusters of green branches and leaves hanging from the upper-right building edge and balcony edge.

entities.name: light-colored cloth bag
entities.identification: The bulging beige-gray bag-shaped objects on the image-left side of the counter and on the adjacent stall rack, with soft oblong outlines.

entities.name: market container
entities.identification: The group of bottles, jars, and buckets in the market, including the brown bottles in the foreground, the yellow bottles and jars in the wide view, and the bucket beside the table.

entities.name: pineapple
entities.identification: The fruit on the orange-fruit table, with a grayish yellow-green oval body and a crown of pointed leaves.

entities.name: smoke and dust near the counter
entities.identification: The billowing translucent reddish-brown and gray smoke-and-dust-like area above and behind the counter.

entities.name: stacked box-shaped goods
entities.identification: The gray-brown, beige, and blue-gray rectangular box-shaped goods stacked near the small table on the image-right.

entities.name: small light-green table
entities.identification: The light-green wooden table on the near side of the shop stall with a red roller shutter, with a tabletop, square legs, and crossbars.

entities.name: overhead cables
entities.identification: The multiple dark thin lines crossing the sky between the buildings.

entities.name: distant person's long gun
entities.identification: The group of dark long guns held by the armed people near the steps, separate from Weapon A and Weapon C.

entities.name: scattered papers on the ground
entities.identification: The scattered light-gray and off-white flat pieces of paper on the paving stones.

entities.name: shallow puddle in the passageway
entities.identification: The irregular reflective area of shallow water in a low part of the paving stones, adjoining the dark wet flagstones.

entities.name: Person C
entities.identification: The short-haired person partially entering the image on the image-left side of the counter, wearing a dark red top and dark pants, who subsequently raises Weapon C.

entities.name: Weapon C
entities.identification: The slender gray-black firearm held by Person C, with silver-gray reflections in parts.
